name: cisco-ios-lsp
description: Context-aware completions, hover docs, and diagnostics for Cisco IOS/IOS-XE config files.

enumDescriptions: Squiggle and an entry in the Problems panel (default).
A subtle blue squiggle; still listed in the Problems panel.
cisco-ios-lsp.diagnostics.unknownCommand.markdownDescription: How to report a top-level command that isn't in the loaded Cisco command references — e.g. a typo, or a command of a platform this extension doesn't cover yet. To silence only a few commands, use `#cisco-ios-lsp.diagnostics.ignoredCommands#`.

cisco-ios-lsp.diagnostics.ignoredCommand.markdownDescription: Commands that are never reported as unknown. Matches whole leading words, any case: `platform qos` covers `platform qos queue-config ...`; a single word covers every line starting with it. Useful per workspace for a platform's extra commands.

cisco-ios-lsp.diagnostics.unusedObjects.markdownDescription: Hint when a class-map, policy-map, ACL, route-map, prefix-list or VRF is defined but never used in the file. Warnings for objects that are used but never defined always stay.

cisco-ios-lsp.diagnostics.indentation.markdownDescription: Report inconsistent indentation, tabs mixed into indentation, and block sub-commands typed without indentation. Format on save fixes exactly these; it follows `editor.formatOnSave`, not this setting.

cisco-ios-lsp.outline.showSymbolsInOutli.description: Show the config structure (interfaces, VRFs, BGP, class-maps, policy-maps) in the Outline panel and breadcrumbs.

command.description: Show prompt commands (hostname# / hostname>) in the outline.

ip_vrf.description: Show VRF declarations ('vrf definition', 'ip vrf') in the outline.

router_bgp.description: Show 'router bgp' blocks in the outline.

sub_interface.description: Show sub-interfaces (e.g. GigabitEthernet0/1.10) in the outline.

cisco-ios-lsp.outline.symbolsList.markdownDescription: Which kinds of blocks appear in the outline: `command` prompt commands (`hostname#`), `ip_vrf` VRFs (`vrf definition`, `ip vrf`), `router_bgp` BGP, `address_family` address families, `class_map` / `policy_map`, `interface` and `sub_interface`.

enumDescriptions: Faint tint behind the placeholder; the text keeps its syntax colour (default).
Quietest look, but closest to how warnings and errors appear.
Most noticeable; replaces the syntax colour of the placeholder.
Most distinct look, still clearly not an error.
No placeholder highlighting (hover note and diagnostics behaviour stay).
cisco-ios-lsp.placeholders.style.markdownDescription: How template placeholders (`<NAME>`, `$VAR`, `{{ jinja }}`, `VlanXX`, `10.10.X.1`) are highlighted. The highlight covers the whole argument. Colours: `ciscoIosLsp.placeholderBackground` / `placeholderUnderline` / `placeholderForeground` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

cisco-ios-lsp.placeholders.fillCharacter.markdownDescription: Characters that mark a value still to be filled in, e.g. `X` for `VlanXX`, `Gi1/0/X`, `X.X.X.X`. Letters are case-sensitive: `X` marks only capitals, `x` only lower case (`xx.xx.xx.xx`, `x.x.x.x`), `Xx` both. A capital counts as a single letter between non-letters or a run of 2+ capitals not touching other capitals (`VlanXX`, `ACL-XXX`, not `MAX`/`XXL`); a lower-case letter counts next to `.` `/` `:` or as a run not touching any other letter (not `Vlanxx`). A symbol counts in any run (`Vlan##`). `<NAME>`, `$VAR`, `${VAR}` and Jinja are always recognised. Avoid common letters (they hide real names) and `#` (it clashes with prompt lines like `SW1#show run`).

cisco-ios-lsp.checkForUpdates.description: For .vsix installs: on startup, check GitHub Releases for a newer version and show a notification. Installs from the VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX update by themselves.

cisco-ios-lsp.experimental.autoIndent.description: Pressing Enter after a block-opening command (interface X, vrf definition Y, ...) indents the next line. Takes effect immediately when toggled.

colors.description: Background of template placeholders (styles A and D).
Dotted underline of template placeholders (styles B and D).
Text colour of template placeholders (style C).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
